<div id="Page1" style="background-color:RGB(256, 256, 256);position:relative;margin-left:auto;margin-right:auto;overflow:hidden;border-style:solid;border-width:thin;border-color:RGB(198, 198, 198);page-break-after:always;width:816px;height:1056px;">

<div id="a0" style="position:absolute;font-family:Calibri;font-size:14.72px;left:66.24px;top:57.5px;">&#160;</div><div id="a1" style="position:absolute;left:545.053px;top:175px;">&#160;</div><div id="a2" style="position:absolute;left:408.067px;top:193.4px;">&#160;</div><div id="a3" style="position:absolute;font-weight:bold;left:300.867px;top:225.4px;">FOR IMMEDIATE RELEASE </div><div id="a5" style="position:absolute;left:66.24px;top:257.4px;">&#160;</div><div id="a6" style="position:absolute;font-weight:bold;left:128.352px;top:279.5px;">CORE MOLDING TECHNOLOGIES ACCELERATES<div style="display:inline-block;width:5.38px">&#160;</div>THE EXPIRATION OF </div><div id="a8" style="position:absolute;font-weight:bold;left:288.387px;top:301.6px;">STOCKHOLDER RIGHTS PLAN<div style="display:inline-block;width:4.2px">&#160;</div></div><div id="a11" style="position:absolute;left:408.067px;top:323.7px;">&#160;</div><div id="a12" style="position:absolute;left:66.24px;top:345.8px;">COLUMBUS, Ohio &#8211; Core Molding Technologies, Inc. (NYSE American: CMT) today announced that its </div><div id="a16" style="position:absolute;left:66.24px;top:367.9px;">board of directors voted to accelerate the expiration of the company&#8217;s<div style="display:inline-block;width:5.97px">&#160;</div>stockholder rights plan to March 31, </div><div id="a17" style="position:absolute;left:66.24px;top:389.9px;">2021 to<div style="display:inline-block;width:9.47px">&#160;</div>further enhance<div style="display:inline-block;width:9.18px">&#160;</div>the company&apos;s<div style="display:inline-block;width:9.34px">&#160;</div>corporate governance<div style="display:inline-block;width:9.31px">&#160;</div>profile. The<div style="display:inline-block;width:9.44px">&#160;</div>stockholder rights<div style="display:inline-block;width:9.39px">&#160;</div>plan was </div><div id="a19" style="position:absolute;left:66.24px;top:412px;">originally scheduled to expire on April 20, 2021.<div style="display:inline-block;width:7.36px">&#160;</div>Stockholders do not have to take any action as a result of </div><div id="a23" style="position:absolute;left:66.24px;top:434.1px;">this accelerated termination. </div><div id="a25" style="position:absolute;left:66.24px;top:456.2px;">&#160;</div><div id="a26" style="position:absolute;left:66.24px;top:478.3px;">The decision to<div style="display:inline-block;width:7.76px">&#160;</div>accelerate the expiration<div style="display:inline-block;width:7.66px">&#160;</div>of the stockholder<div style="display:inline-block;width:7.68px">&#160;</div>rights plan<div style="display:inline-block;width:6.66px">&#160;</div>was the result<div style="display:inline-block;width:7.86px">&#160;</div>of careful analysis </div><div id="a28" style="position:absolute;left:66.24px;top:500.3px;">including input from corporate<div style="display:inline-block;width:1.24px">&#160;</div>governance experts. The plan<div style="display:inline-block;width:1.4px">&#160;</div>was adopted in<div style="display:inline-block;width:1.94px">&#160;</div>April of 2020<div style="display:inline-block;width:2.02px">&#160;</div>to protect against </div><div id="a29" style="position:absolute;left:66.24px;top:522.4px;">any potential future use of<div style="display:inline-block;width:5.65px">&#160;</div>coercive or abusive takeover techniques and<div style="display:inline-block;width:5.98px">&#160;</div>to help ensure that the Company&#8217;s </div><div id="a30" style="position:absolute;left:66.24px;top:544.5px;">stockholders were not deprived<div style="display:inline-block;width:6.02px">&#160;</div>of the opportunity to<div style="display:inline-block;width:6.26px">&#160;</div>realize the full and<div style="display:inline-block;width:6.11px">&#160;</div>fair value of their<div style="display:inline-block;width:6.1px">&#160;</div>investment.<div style="display:inline-block;width:8.32px">&#160;</div>In </div><div id="a34" style="position:absolute;left:66.24px;top:566.6px;">adopting the plan, the<div style="display:inline-block;width:2.01px">&#160;</div>Board had taken note<div style="display:inline-block;width:2.16px">&#160;</div>of the unprecedented impact of<div style="display:inline-block;width:1.94px">&#160;</div>the COVID-19 pandemic on the </div><div id="a37" style="position:absolute;left:66.24px;top:588.7px;">Company, including<div style="display:inline-block;width:6.7px">&#160;</div>in the Company&#8217;s<div style="display:inline-block;width:7.28px">&#160;</div>stock price, the<div style="display:inline-block;width:6.61px">&#160;</div>substantial increase in<div style="display:inline-block;width:6.55px">&#160;</div>trading volume and<div style="display:inline-block;width:6.63px">&#160;</div>market </div><div id="a39" style="position:absolute;left:66.24px;top:610.8px;">volatility, and<div style="display:inline-block;width:6.72px">&#160;</div>the significant impact<div style="display:inline-block;width:6.33px">&#160;</div>the pandemic had<div style="display:inline-block;width:6.68px">&#160;</div>across the manufacturing<div style="display:inline-block;width:6.53px">&#160;</div>industry.<div style="display:inline-block;width:10.01px">&#160;</div>At the time<div style="display:inline-block;width:6.58px">&#160;</div>of </div><div id="a43" style="position:absolute;left:66.24px;top:632.9px;">adoption of<div style="display:inline-block;width:8.76px">&#160;</div>the plan<div style="display:inline-block;width:8.91px">&#160;</div>the Company&#8217;s<div style="display:inline-block;width:9.8px">&#160;</div>stock price<div style="display:inline-block;width:8.97px">&#160;</div>was trading<div style="display:inline-block;width:8.84px">&#160;</div>at approximately<div style="display:inline-block;width:9px">&#160;</div>$2.40 per<div style="display:inline-block;width:8.85px">&#160;</div>share. Shares </div><div id="a45" style="position:absolute;left:66.24px;top:654.9px;">currently trade at approximately $11.50 per share, a 380% increase.<div style="display:inline-block;width:12.78px">&#160;</div></div><div id="a47" style="position:absolute;left:66.24px;top:677px;">&#160;</div><div id="a48" style="position:absolute;left:66.24px;top:699.1px;">&#8220;The acceleration of the expiration of the<div style="display:inline-block;width:5.89px">&#160;</div>stockholder rights plan demonstrates the Board&apos;s commitment<div style="display:inline-block;width:5.74px">&#160;</div>to </div><div id="a49" style="position:absolute;left:66.24px;top:721.2px;">best  corporate  governance  practices.  Our  decision  incorporates  valuable  shareholder  feedback,  while </div><div id="a51" style="position:absolute;left:66.24px;top:743.3px;">ensuring that we have appropriate measures and policies in place to manage our business effectively,&#8221;<div style="display:inline-block;width:6.28px">&#160;</div>said </div><div id="a52" style="position:absolute;left:66.24px;top:765.3px;">David L. Duvall, president and chief executive officer. </div><div id="a54" style="position:absolute;left:66.24px;top:787.5px;">&#160;</div><div id="a55" style="position:absolute;font-weight:bold;left:66.24px;top:809.5px;">About Core Molding Technologies,<div style="display:inline-block;width:5.84px">&#160;</div>Inc. </div><div id="a57" style="position:absolute;font-weight:bold;left:66.24px;top:831.6px;">&#160;</div><div id="a58" style="position:absolute;left:66.24px;top:853.7px;">Core Molding<div style="display:inline-block;width:11.7px">&#160;</div>Technologies is<div style="display:inline-block;width:12.76px">&#160;</div>a manufacturer<div style="display:inline-block;width:11.62px">&#160;</div>of sheet<div style="display:inline-block;width:11.56px">&#160;</div>molding compound<div style="display:inline-block;width:11.76px">&#160;</div>(&quot;SMC&quot;) and<div style="display:inline-block;width:11.7px">&#160;</div>molder of </div><div id="a60" style="position:absolute;left:66.24px;top:875.8px;">thermoset and<div style="display:inline-block;width:7.72px">&#160;</div>thermoplastic products.<div style="display:inline-block;width:7.89px">&#160;</div>The Company<div style="display:inline-block;width:7.79px">&#160;</div>operates in<div style="display:inline-block;width:7.69px">&#160;</div>one operating<div style="display:inline-block;width:7.84px">&#160;</div>segment as<div style="display:inline-block;width:7.75px">&#160;</div>a molder<div style="display:inline-block;width:7.74px">&#160;</div>of </div><div id="a61" style="position:absolute;left:66.24px;top:897.9px;">thermoplastic and thermoset (plastic)<div style="display:inline-block;width:1.34px">&#160;</div>structural products. The Company&apos;s<div style="display:inline-block;width:1.55px">&#160;</div>operating segment consists of<div style="display:inline-block;width:1.59px">&#160;</div>two </div><div id="a63" style="position:absolute;left:66.24px;top:919.9px;">component reporting units,<div style="display:inline-block;width:2.02px">&#160;</div>Core Traditional and Horizon<div style="display:inline-block;width:1.88px">&#160;</div>Plastics. The Company produces<div style="display:inline-block;width:1.46px">&#160;</div>and sells molded </div><div id="a64" style="position:absolute;left:66.24px;top:942px;">products for varied<div style="display:inline-block;width:6.75px">&#160;</div>markets, including medium<div style="display:inline-block;width:7.04px">&#160;</div>and heavy-duty trucks,<div style="display:inline-block;width:6.71px">&#160;</div>automobiles, marine, construction </div><div id="a67" style="position:absolute;left:66.24px;top:964.1px;">and other commercial markets. The Company offers customers a wide range of manufacturing<div style="display:inline-block;width:2.33px">&#160;</div>processes to </div></div>
</div>
<div style="padding: 7px">
<div id="Page2" style="background-color:RGB(256, 256, 256);position:relative;margin-left:auto;margin-right:auto;overflow:hidden;border-style:solid;border-width:thin;border-color:RGB(198, 198, 198);page-break-after:always;width:816px;height:1056px;">
<div id="a69" style="position:absolute;left:66.24px;top:57.9px;">fit various program volume and investment requirements.<div style="display:inline-block;width:2.05px">&#160;</div>These processes include compression molding of </div><div id="a70" style="position:absolute;left:66.24px;top:80px;">SMC,  bulk<div style="display:inline-block;width:15.2px">&#160;</div>molding  compounds<div style="display:inline-block;width:15.13px">&#160;</div>(&quot;BMC&quot;),  resin<div style="display:inline-block;width:15.05px">&#160;</div>transfer  molding<div style="display:inline-block;width:15.24px">&#160;</div>(&quot;RTM&quot;),  liquid<div style="display:inline-block;width:16.11px">&#160;</div>molding  of </div><div id="a72" style="position:absolute;left:66.24px;top:102.1px;">dicyclopentadiene (&quot;DCPD&quot;),<div style="display:inline-block;width:7.29px">&#160;</div>spray-up and<div style="display:inline-block;width:7.06px">&#160;</div>hand-lay-up, direct<div style="display:inline-block;width:7.39px">&#160;</div>long-fiber thermoplastics<div style="display:inline-block;width:7.22px">&#160;</div>(&quot;D-LFT&quot;) and </div><div id="a83" style="position:absolute;left:66.24px;top:124.1px;">structural  foam  and<div style="display:inline-block;width:10.32px">&#160;</div>structural  web  injection<div style="display:inline-block;width:10.54px">&#160;</div>molding  (&quot;SIM&quot;).  Core<div style="display:inline-block;width:10.43px">&#160;</div>Molding  Technologies<div style="display:inline-block;width:10.68px">&#160;</div>has  its </div><div id="a84" style="position:absolute;left:66.24px;top:146.2px;">headquarters in<div style="display:inline-block;width:7.74px">&#160;</div>Columbus, Ohio,<div style="display:inline-block;width:7.81px">&#160;</div>and operates<div style="display:inline-block;width:7.59px">&#160;</div>production facilities<div style="display:inline-block;width:7.82px">&#160;</div>in Columbus,<div style="display:inline-block;width:7.85px">&#160;</div>Ohio; Gaffney,<div style="display:inline-block;width:8.95px">&#160;</div>South </div><div id="a86" style="position:absolute;left:66.24px;top:168.3px;">Carolina; Winona,<div style="display:inline-block;width:9.65px">&#160;</div>Minnesota; Matamoros<div style="display:inline-block;width:9.05px">&#160;</div>and Escobedo,<div style="display:inline-block;width:8.94px">&#160;</div>Mexico; and<div style="display:inline-block;width:9.02px">&#160;</div>Cobourg, Ontario,<div style="display:inline-block;width:9.33px">&#160;</div>Canada. For </div><div id="a87" style="position:absolute;left:66.24px;top:190.4px;">further information, visit the company&apos;s website at www.coremt.com. </div><div id="a89" style="position:absolute;left:66.24px;top:212.5px;">&#160;</div><div id="a90" style="position:absolute;left:66.24px;top:234.5px;">&#160;</div></div>
